### Why book group flights with Airlines Group Travel?

Booking ten or more seats is different from booking one. Airlines release limited group inventory with its own rules. We handle that for you.

### Group flight FAQs

**Q: How many passengers count as a group booking?**

Most airlines treat 10 or more passengers travelling together on the same itinerary as a group. If your party is smaller, call us anyway — we can often still find fares that keep everyone together.

**Q: How do I get a group flight quote?**

Call +1-888-609-1015 (24/7) or send the quote form with your route, dates, number of travelers and cabin class. A group travel specialist compares options across airlines and gets back to you with a quote.

**Q: Is a group fare cheaper than booking individual tickets?**

Often, yes. Group fares can be lower than the public fares for the same seats, and they usually come with added flexibility such as a small deposit, later name submission and a single locked-in fare for the whole group. Savings depend on the airline, route and travel dates.

**Q: Do I need all passenger names when I book?**

Usually not. Many airline group contracts let you hold seats with a deposit and submit final passenger names closer to departure. Name deadlines vary by airline and are confirmed in your quote.

**Q: Can I book now and pay later?**

Many group contracts need only a deposit to hold the seats, with the balance due before ticketing. Your specialist explains the deposit and payment schedule for your group before you commit.

## Group flight booking services

URL: https://airlinesgrouptravel.codeberg.page/group-flights/

### What is a group flight booking?

A group booking reserves seats for 10 or more passengers travelling together on the same flights. Airlines price and manage these bookings separately from individual tickets. Group bookings usually include a negotiated fare, a deposit to hold the seats, and a later deadline for passenger names and final payment.

### What's included when you book with us
- Group fare comparisons across multiple airlines and routings
- Economy, premium economy, business and first-class quotes
- Round-trip, one-way and multi-city itineraries
- Groups departing from several cities and meeting at one destination
- Help with deposit schedules, name lists and ticketing deadlines
- Seating requests, special assistance and schedule-change support

### Group types we specialize in

### Sports teams
Tournament and league travel for teams, coaches and supporters, with dates matched to your fixtures.

### Weddings & family events
Destination weddings, reunions and milestone celebrations, keeping the whole family on one itinerary.

### Corporate & conferences
Meetings, incentives, trade shows and offsites, with name-change flexibility for busy teams.

### Schools & students
Class trips, study abroad, choirs and bands, with chaperone-friendly seating and deposit plans.

### Religious & mission trips
Pilgrimages, church groups and mission teams travelling to one destination together.

### Tours & leisure groups
Tour operators, clubs and friends travelling together on domestic or international holidays.

### Tips for a smooth group booking
- Book early. Airlines limit how many group seats they sell on each flight. Aim for 3 to 11 months ahead.
- Be flexible where you can. Moving your dates by a day, or choosing a nearby airport, can lower the group fare a lot.
- Know your headcount range. Give us a minimum and maximum. Many contracts allow some attrition before a deadline.
- Collect names early. Names must match government ID exactly, so start collecting them early.

Airlines Group Travel started in 2022 to make group air travel simpler. Coordinating flights for a team, a wedding party or a company is complicated: limited seats, name deadlines, deposits and many travelers to keep informed. Our group travel specialists handle those details so organizers can focus on the trip itself.

We are a US travel agency operated by Airfare Services USA LLC and based in Dover, Delaware. We book group airfare on most major domestic and international airlines, in every cabin class.

## Group flight booking FAQ

URL: https://airlinesgrouptravel.codeberg.page/faq/

**Q: How many passengers count as a group booking?**

Most airlines treat 10 or more passengers travelling together on the same itinerary as a group. If your party is smaller, call us anyway — we can often still find fares that keep everyone together.

**Q: How do I get a group flight quote?**

Call +1-888-609-1015 (24/7) or send the quote form with your route, dates, number of travelers and cabin class. A group travel specialist compares options across airlines and gets back to you with a quote.

**Q: Is a group fare cheaper than booking individual tickets?**

Often, yes. Group fares can be lower than the public fares for the same seats, and they usually come with added flexibility such as a small deposit, later name submission and a single locked-in fare for the whole group. Savings depend on the airline, route and travel dates.

**Q: Do I need all passenger names when I book?**

Usually not. Many airline group contracts let you hold seats with a deposit and submit final passenger names closer to departure. Name deadlines vary by airline and are confirmed in your quote.

**Q: Can I book now and pay later?**

Many group contracts need only a deposit to hold the seats, with the balance due before ticketing. Your specialist explains the deposit and payment schedule for your group before you commit.

**Q: Which airlines can you book for groups?**

We can book group travel on most major US and international airlines, including American, Delta, United, Southwest, Alaska, JetBlue, Lufthansa, British Airways, Emirates and Qatar Airways. We are an independent agency and not affiliated with any airline.

**Q: Can you book business class or first class for groups?**

Yes. We quote economy, premium economy, business and first class for groups, and can mix cabins within one group when needed.

**Q: How far in advance should we book group flights?**

As early as possible — ideally 3 to 11 months before departure. Group seat inventory is limited per flight, and booking early gives you the best choice of fares and schedules.

**Q: Can passengers travel from different cities?**

Yes. We can coordinate groups flying from several departure cities so that everyone arrives at the destination together.

**Q: Is Airlines Group Travel an airline?**

No. Airlines Group Travel is an independent travel agency run by Airfare Services USA LLC in Dover, Delaware. Our main website is www.airlinesgrouptravel.com.

Still have a question? Call +1-888-609-1015 or email info@airlinesgrouptravel.com.

## Privacy Policy

URL: https://airlinesgrouptravel.codeberg.page/privacy-policy/

Last updated: 2026-09-30

This Privacy Policy explains how Airfare Services USA LLC ("Airlines Group Travel", "we", "us") collects and uses information on airlinesgrouptravel.codeberg.page.

### Information we collect
- Quote requests: your name, email, phone number, travel details and any message you send through our forms.
- Communications: records of calls and emails with our specialists.
- Technical data: the page you submitted a form from. This site uses no advertising cookies.

### How we use it
- To prepare and send group travel quotes and to contact you about your request.
- To make bookings you ask for, which means sharing passenger details with airlines and travel suppliers.
- To meet legal, accounting and fraud-prevention obligations.

### Sharing

We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with airlines and suppliers needed for your booking, with service providers who store data for us (for example, Google Workspace), or when the law requires it.

### Retention

We keep quote requests for as long as we need them to serve you and meet legal obligations, then delete them.

### Your choices

You can ask to see, correct or delete your information, or opt out of follow-up contact, by emailing info@airlinesgrouptravel.com. California residents may have extra rights under the CCPA/CPRA.

### Hosting

This website is hosted on Codeberg Pages. Codeberg may process server logs such as IP addresses to operate the service.

### Contact

Airfare Services USA LLC, 8 The Green, Suite A, Dover, DE 19901, USA · +1-888-609-1015

## Terms & Conditions

URL: https://airlinesgrouptravel.codeberg.page/terms/

Last updated: 2026-09-30

These terms govern your use of airlinesgrouptravel.codeberg.page, operated by Airfare Services USA LLC ("Airlines Group Travel").

### Our role

Airlines Group Travel is an independent travel agency. We are not an airline. Air transportation is provided by the airline shown on your ticket, under that airline's conditions of carriage.

### Quotes and fares

Quotes are estimates based on availability at the time they are given. Fares, taxes and seat availability are not guaranteed until the airline confirms the booking and tickets are issued.

### Deposits, names and payments

Group bookings follow the deposit, name-submission, payment and cancellation rules of the airline's group contract. We tell you these rules in writing before you confirm. Missing a deadline can mean losing seats or deposits.

### Changes and cancellations

Changes and cancellations follow airline rules and may cost extra fees. Our service fees, if any, are disclosed before booking. See the refund policy on our main website for details.

### Travel documents

Each traveler is responsible for valid passports, visas and health documents, and for making sure names match government ID.

### Website content

Information on this site is general and may change. Airline names and trademarks belong to their owners and are used only for identification.

### Limitation of liability

To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for airline schedule changes, cancellations, delays or other acts of suppliers outside our control.

### Contact

Questions? Call +1-888-609-1015 or email info@airlinesgrouptravel.com.

## Does Volaris Do Group Bookings?

URL: https://airlinesgrouptravel.codeberg.page/blog/does-volaris-do-group-bookings/
Published: 2026-10-07

Exploring destinations with large parties with the Mexican low-cost carrier, Volaris, is an exhilarating experience for individuals. The airline provides group travel services across national and international routes. In this way, it aids those intending to fly together with their loved ones within a single travel plan. Furthermore, the carrier offers uncomplicated ways to make a Volaris Airlines group booking without facing any complexities and provides several benefits as well when accessing the service. But to do that, individuals are required to comply with the minimum group travel conditions set by the airline. To get deeper insights about the topic, go through the elaborated sections below and curate a smooth journey with companions.

### Is It Better to Book Flights as a Group on Volaris Airlines?

Indeed! Booking a group trip with Volaris is better for the flyers than purchasing separate tickets for each individual. This is because Volaris Airlines Group Travel service offers a number of benefits that are designed especially for large crowds traveling together. Such advantages include seamless booking procedures, flexible payment and name-changing policies, reduced rates, and many other perks that enhance the overall flying experience of the flyers.

### How Can I Book a Group Flight with Volaris Airlines?

On Volaris Airlines, making bookings for a large group is simple with the services the carrier provides. Passengers don't have to go through complicated processes or get multiple tickets for everyone. Instead, the bookings can be made under a unified method, which brings better management and organization within the group. Aside from this, one can reach out to the carrier by using the Volaris group travel phone number, which is 1 (855) 8652-747, for seat reservations. Additionally, the official webpage of the airline can also be utilized by the travelers to make the bookings. For more clarity about the latter procedure, check the section given below.

### Reserve the Volaris Airlines Group Travel Tickets Through the Official Website:

Booking tickets for large gatherings on Volaris through the website is preferable for the passengers. The procedure allows travelers to directly make the bookings by using the Volaris Group bookings portal without involving any intermediaries. Along with that, they can also learn more about the facility by going through the webpage and learn about the current promotional or offer period as well. The procedure can be understood better by referring to the steps listed below.
- Open the Volaris Airlines official web portal to start the booking process.
- Then, select the "Groups" option by scrolling a little down on the homepage.
- Now, use the credentials to log in or sign up for an account to continue.
- Once done, fill out the application form with all the required trip details, and the airline will share an official quote in ten minutes.
- After receiving the quote, accept it within the defined time period, which should not be missed, and make the payment.
- Next, share the names of all flyers, and the final tickets will be sent by the airline to the registered email ID of the applicant.

### Conclusion

Therefore, taking tickets for flights with peers is a joyful trip experience for individuals on Volaris. This is due to its dedicated group travel service, which allows passengers to be on the same route and carrier with their loved ones. Not only this, but the airline also offers numerous benefits when booking Volaris Airlines group flights that let the flyers enjoy a fulfilling journey at reasonable rates. Aside from this, to have such a satisfying trip with loved ones or known faces, refer to the aforementioned headings thoroughly.

## How to Book a Flight for a Large Group with PAL?

URL: https://airlinesgrouptravel.codeberg.page/blog/how-to-book-a-flight-for-a-large-group-with-pal/
Published: 2026-10-06

Organizing a journey with larger groups feels like a different kind of excitement in one's heart. This can be initiated with the oldest commercial airline in Asia, Philippine Airlines. This airline is good at offering exclusive services to its passengers at a reasonable rate. Moreover, traveling with a large number of passengers can be done through its group flights. These flights are provided under the Philippine Airlines group travel program that allows one to travel together with their companions. Along with this, they also provide several premium perks that are usually not offered on regular bookings. Other than that, one can generate their tickets through a straightforward method. Thus, to learn about all this, one can read the outlines below.

### Does Philippine Airlines Do Group Booking?

Yes, PAL does offer a group booking program to its passengers. Traveling groups that are looking for a comfortable service from the airline can choose this one. With its shared flights, one can fly together with their companions using a single itinerary. Moreover, with these Philippine Airlines group bookings, passengers get to enjoy several deals and amenities that are offered for the journey. Therefore, flying on this airline is definitely going to provide several memorable experiences.

### What Are the Group Booking Policies on Philippine Airlines?

Traveling with Philippine Airlines is much smoother when one is aware of the conditions of the airline. By doing so, travelers can get access to several deals and offerings of the airline that are only provided on group travel. Moreover, these stipulations are easy to align with and are applied to each party member. Thus, to gain more information about this, one can read the following guidelines.
- A flyer needs at least 10 passengers flying together to book as a group.
- Passengers' details must be submitted before the due date.
- Flight seats will be secured only when the full payment is made.
- Cancellation must be made 24 hours before departure to avoid unnecessary fees.

### How to Book a Flight for a Large Group with PAL?

Reserving the group flight on PAL for numerous flyers is simple because of the online web portal. Through this method, the party leader can make the reservation for all the members of the party. Moreover, with this Philippine Airlines Group Booking page, they can also get to know about the current deals and offerings of the airline. Other than that, the flyer only has to fill out a form to get the tickets with no hassle. Thus, one can learn the booking steps from the pointers below.
- Reach out to the official website of Philippine Airlines.
- Go to the "Book" icon and then to the "Group booking" option.
- Now, click on the first link displayed on the screen.
- After this, choose the "Group Bookings" option.
- Pick the required category, either "New Group Booking Request" or "Existing Booking Request."
- Now, complete the form by filling out all the details and submit it.
- After a while, the group quote will be shared via email, along with the airfare.
- Accept it before the given deadline and proceed to make the payment.
- Thereafter, share the names of all the party members.
- At the end, get the tickets sent to the registered email.

### Conclusion

Hence, these group flights with PAL are not as complicated as assumed by travelers. Moreover, this airline provides discounts to the group that follows its terms and conditions. Further, the travelers get to relax knowing that the airline offers an easily accessible method to book flights through the online platform. Besides, for any doubts or queries, one can reach out to the group desk team.

## How to Book Flights for Group with JetBlue?

URL: https://airlinesgrouptravel.codeberg.page/blog/how-to-book-flights-for-group-with-jetblue/
Published: 2026-10-05

A journey planned with several individuals is going to provide an enchanting experience for all. These kinds of trips can be curated by choosing JetBlue as a travel partner. This airline is ideal for flying to any stunning location, from domestic to international destinations. Other than that, when traveling with numerous flyers, one can go with the JetBlue group travel service that allows them to fly together. With this, travelers can acquire tickets and various deals at a reasonable price. All this happens when the passenger aligns with the airlines policies. Therefore, to learn more about this topic, one can read the following sections described herein.

### What Are the Group Booking Terms & Conditions on JetBlue?

A group trip can only be initiated when all the travelers become eligible according to the conditions of JetBlue. These conditions are specifically applied to the JetBlue group travel reservation and provide numerous benefits to each individual. Other than that, complying with its rules and regulations will lead to a smoother and more comfortable journey with a lot of fun. Therefore, the complete explanation of these guidelines is provided in the bullet points herein.
- There must be at least 10 passengers in a group to fly together.
- An initial non-refundable deposit is required to confirm the flight seats.
- Any changes in travelers' names can be made for an extra fee until 72 hours before departure.

### How to Book Flights for Group with JetBlue?

Making a group reservation on JetBlue is way easier because of its official website, which is quick and convenient to use. However, the airline also provides its group desk number for JetBlue group bookings, which is 1-888-JETBLUE (1-888-538-2583). By using this, passengers can directly communicate with the professionals and ask their questions. Moreover, a detailed explanation of the reservation process through the online platform is provided herein.
- Browse the official website of JetBlue.
- Move to the "Travel Info" icon and choose "Group Bookings."
- Scroll down further and click on the “submit a request for a group booking” link mentioned in the section below.
- Now, fill in the form with all the required details and submit it.
- Soon, the airline will share the price quotation.
- Accept it and confirm before the prescribed timeline.
- Next, make the payment and share the accompanying travelers’ details with the airline.
- Finally, the ticket itinerary will be shared to the provided email.

### Does JetBlue Offer Discounts for Group Travel?

Yes, JetBlue does provide a special discount on its group travel service. Through this offering, flyers can travel at an affordable rate, which is cheaper than regular bookings. Further, with this JetBlue group travel discount, the flyer can avail various other perks that provide a comfortable experience throughout the journey. These deals make the whole trip even more memorable and exciting for travelers.

### Conclusion

Thus, a shared journey with JetBlue always provides various lucrative advantages to the travelers. The detailed knowledge about its group services is explained in the above highlights. Moreover, the passengers can experience its several amenities and dedicated assistance from the staff. Other than that, the group tickets are provided with special discounts to keep the journey within budget. Overall, the experience on its group flights makes one want to go again and again.

## How to Book Cabo Verde Airlines Tickets for a Group?

URL: https://airlinesgrouptravel.codeberg.page/blog/how-to-book-cabo-verde-airlines-tickets-for-a-group/
Published: 2026-10-01

An expedition scheduled with Cabo Verde Airlines is bound to be compelling and comfortable. This airline is recognized by travelers for its exclusive travel services that cater to different passenger trip requirements, including groups. When travelers have to take a Cabo Verde Airlines flight with their companions, they can choose its group travel service. With this, they will be able to secure a larger block of seats on the same flight to the same destination. Moreover, there are a number of advantages that make Cabo Verde Airlines group travel option more relevant and convenient for their collective journey. Learning more about this travel feature of the airline could be worthwhile for planning a shared journey. Therefore, travelers can refer to the headings highlighted below to grab that information.

### What Are the Advantages of Group Booking on Cabo Verde?

Travelers flying with Cabo Verde Airlines reach their destination in full comfort while benefiting from many travel features. Not only can individual flyers avail such an experience, but also those flying in a group. Even travelers using the Cabo Verde Airlines group booking option enjoy extra facilities and benefits throughout their journey. By reading the following points, one will be able to learn about the advantages of group booking.
- Enjoy special group fares that can make the trip more economical.
- Get flexible options for submitting or changing passenger names.
- Benefit from convenient payment options for the booking.
- Group bookings can offer better flexibility and easier travel management.
- Save time by handling the party reservation in one booking.

### How to Book Cabo Verde Airlines Tickets for a Group?

Seats for groups of individuals can be reserved under the same flight segment with Cabo Verde Airlines effortlessly. For that, travelers have to submit the form with the mandatory details. Moreover, they will be able to find the Cabo Verde Airlines Group Travel Form by accessing its official website. There are very simple steps to reach the airline's website and complete the reservation. Travelers can learn them in detail by taking a look at the steps below.
- Visit the official Cabo Verde Airlines website.
- Go to the homepage and opt for "Group Booking."
- Then, enter all the required details in the booking form and click "Submit."
- Now, the airline will send a quotation.
- After receiving the offer, review and confirm it before the deadline.
- Further, pay the ticket amount using one of the available payment methods.
- Thereafter, upload the names and required details of all passengers.
- Finally, get the confirmed flight tickets at the registered email address.

### Does Cabo Verde Airlines Offer Group Discounts?

Indeed! Group discounts are offered by Cabo Verde Airlines. With such special offers from the airline, multiple companions will not have to worry about their budget. However, the airline may make these discounts available for groups that have more than 9 passengers with a common travel plan. Aside from this, arranging flights in advance can increase the chances of availing Cabo Verde Airlines group discounts without adding extra services. Also, flyers might need to choose seasons to fly when travel demand is low.

### Conclusion

So, group travel is a unique offering of Cabo Verde Airlines. Passengers using it can fly with their known ones seamlessly and acquire an array of travel benefits. But shared journeys have to be arranged by complying with the airline's stipulations and guidelines. When these terms are followed, no one faces trouble while making their reservation and flying together with their companions. On the other hand, flyers can contact the airline's live agent for any issues with the group booking or related matters about its services.

## How Can I Book a Group Flight on Ethiopian Airlines?

URL: https://airlinesgrouptravel.codeberg.page/blog/how-can-i-book-a-group-flight-on-ethiopian-airlines/
Published: 2026-09-29

Passengers can embark on an enhanced escape with Ethiopian Airlines. This airline is known to offer a wide range of services on its distinct routes. Moreover, travelers can plan a solo or collective trip with these travel features. In such cases, flyers offer special group travel services for those passengers who prefer traveling together. But to get Ethiopian Airlines group travel tickets, there are requirements for travelers seeking to complete their journey together. Before planning the trip, one must consider those factors. By doing so, accessing the airline's exclusive travel facilities and special fares makes air travel easier. Besides, the information that is required to arrange shared voyages is as follows.

### What Is the Group Booking Policy on Ethiopian Airlines?

Travelers seeking to fly together with their companions can take an Ethiopian Airlines flight. Since such travel includes several passengers, the airline follows certain conditions to keep the reservation properly structured. The Ethiopian Airlines group booking policy makes the reservation process smoother by letting passengers know every requirement of flying together. Also, taking a quick look at them beforehand can avoid confusion during the booking or later on. The important points related to these policies are mentioned below.
- The airline allows more than 9 companions to fly in a group to the same destination, and they have to fly through one or more flight segments under the same reservation.
- A single reservation can include up to 99 flyers. But seats can be pre-reserved for only 50 passengers at a time. If the itinerary has all 99 members, two PNRs have to be created for issuing the seats.
- Names need to be submitted 60 days before departure. If a traveler cannot provide the name by that date, the name may be submitted 30 days before takeoff.
- A group itinerary may also be cancelled by the traveler when the option is mentioned in the airline's offer.
- The reservation may no longer qualify as group travel when the cancellation reduces the party size to 9 flyers or fewer.

### How Can I Book a Group Flight on Ethiopian Airlines?

Ethiopian Airlines provides travelers with a dedicated way to put forward an inquiry for group travel on the basis of their proposed itinerary. This airline lets eligible passengers visit its official website and submit the required information to initiate the request. The Ethiopian Airlines group flight booking request can then be reviewed by the concerned team, after which a quotation may be shared according to the travel requirements. The complete method for submitting the group travel request is outlined in the steps below.
- Head to the group portal of Ethiopian Airlines.
- New users can create an account, while registered users can sign in directly.
- Afterward, find the group travel option and access the form.
- Enter the required information in the form and send the request.
- The airline will check the request and return a quotation for the trip.
- Go through the offer and accept it before the stated expiry time.
- Then, pay the initial deposit first, followed by the remaining amount as instructed.
- Once the payment is done, add the names of all passengers within the given deadline.
- After the final details are received, the group itinerary or tickets will arrive by email.

###

### Does Ethiopian Airlines Offer Group Discounts?

Indeed! Travelers can acquire group discounts on Ethiopian Airlines. But for that, they have to fly with multiple individuals. Basically, these discounts apply to the Ethiopian Airlines group booking, which is made for 10 or more familiar flyers. Not only special fares, but the airline also offers groups flexible name changes and submission options. Also, flyers might be able to secure their reservation with a small deposit.

The applicable requirements, booking provisions and related formalities give travelers a better understanding of how their journey can be taken forward. By going through the Ethiopian Airlines group ticket booking details discussed above, one can prepare their plans with greater clarity and keep the necessary arrangements in order. ## How Can I Book a Group Flight with Alaska Airlines?

URL: https://airlinesgrouptravel.codeberg.page/blog/how-can-i-book-a-group-flight-with-alaska-airlines/
Published: 2026-09-28

Trips planned with loved ones, which include multiple companions, are quite special and captivating. This can become much easier to plan when done with Alaska Airlines. The major U.S. carrier runs a specialized group travel program that allows passengers to fly together with a number of individuals without any complications. Furthermore, by accessing the Alaska Airlines Group Travel feature, one would be able to secure special rates and added advantages, which elevate the overall flying experience of the individuals. But to obtain these facilities, they have to maintain the rules and regulations first, which can be found in the titles mentioned below. So, read ahead to get familiar with the topic and curate a soothing trip with known faces.

### What Are the Group Booking Terms & Conditions of Alaska Airlines?

Traveling with large parties on Alaska Airlines is convenient and easily accessible for passengers. However, to do that, they are required to meet the minimum requirements of the airline before booking the seats. Furthermore, travelers can easily request a quote by complying with the Alaska Airlines Group Booking terms and conditions. This will also lead them to acquire the discounted rates & privileges that come along with the facility. Additionally, being aware of the guidelines would aid individuals in staying informed and mindful while making decisions about their trip. The following pointers carry detailed information about the guidelines, so refer to them.
- To opt for the group travel feature, the group must contain more than nine passengers.
- The carrier also allows individuals to book tickets 11 months prior to the scheduled departure.
- In place of those flyers who are unable to join on the day of travel, the airline permits substitute travelers.
- Modifications to the individual's names can be made for free up to 72 hours before takeoff.
- Flyers don’t have to pay any deposit to hold the reservations while booking the seats.

### How to Book a Group Flight on Alaska Airlines?

Flying with big groups has become uncomplicated with Alaska Airlines. Similarly, making reservations for the same can also be done efficiently without going through any complications & hassle. This is due to the procedure the carrier provides for making bookings, which is by reaching out to the Alaska Group desk by calling 1-800-445-4435. In this way, one can easily secure the tickets at their own pace and convenience. For more insights about it, check the provided section.
- To begin the reservation procedure, contact the airline by using the above-mentioned phone number.
- Then, transfer the travel details and other requirements over the call with the airline.
- On the basis of the information provided to them, an official quote will be released within two business days.
- Review and accept it within the given timeframe, and proceed with making the payment.
- This can be done by using the available methods mentioned in the quote.
- Afterwards, submit the names of each flyer before the deadline ends and receive the final tickets to the registered email account of the applicant.
